key_insight: BRIDGE provides paired prostate biopsy whole-slide images across three preparation stages to support AI research in label-free virtual staining and related tasks.
clinical_relevance: The dataset could support research on reducing reliance on chemical staining and evaluating cancer grading concordance, but clinical performance is not established here.
method: Digitized each slide sequentially in paraffin, after deparaffinization, and after H&E staining.
Paired images across preparation stages and provided slide-level Gleason scores.
De-identified images in native scanner format for planned release through BioImage Archive.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 2,607 whole-slide images from 869 slides and 169 patients at one Polish oncology centre, without model performance results.
watch_item: Single-centre sourcing may limit generalizability; models developed using BRIDGE require independent validation.
paper_title: The BRIDGE dataset: paired brightfield whole-slide images of prostate core-needle biopsies in paraffin, after deparaffinization and H&E staining
